body:
Concentrated triage batch: `finding` → `pm:queue` + `domain:devx`, Task — the `no-unprefixed-query-params` rule is AST-anchored and the fourth #5458 site lives inside a template-literal page source, structurally invisible to ESLint. Fix direction (dev measures which is cheaper and more durable): extract the workbench-preview page source into a real module the rule can parse, or add a targeted secondary scan for `find(`/`findOne(` inside page-source template literals in the harness files. Acceptance: re-introducing the fourth site's defect reds a gate.

Claiming this issue.

- Session: `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`
- Branch: `claude/issue-5944-preview-source-query-params`

Plan: add a sibling test in the `apps/console/src/__tests__/sdui-preview-page-source-styling.test.ts` family that enumerates `*-preview.tsx` harnesses via `import.meta.glob('../*-preview.tsx', { query: '?raw' })`, extracts each page object's `source`, parses it, and asserts no unprefixed query option in `find`/`findOne` params — reusing the ESLint rule's own key map rather than duplicating it.

Added apps/console/src/__tests__/sdui-preview-page-source-query-params.test.ts, which extracts each preview harness's page source and runs the REAL eslint-rules/no-unprefixed-query-params.js over it via ESLint's Linter -- the rule's own anchor works perfectly once the subject is the extracted source instead of the harness. Extraction moved into a new shared helper (apps/console/src/__tests__/helpers/preview-page-sources.ts) that owns the single import.meta.glob enumeration and the single extractor; the styling test was MIGRATED onto it rather than the extractor being copied, since two enumerations cannot deliver 'a new harness is covered automatically'. The extractor now parses the harness (typescript-eslint parser) and returns the template literal's COOKED value, because the raw text of the workbench source is not parseable JS -- its \\u{...} glyph escape reads as JSX text plus an expression container ('Parsing error: Identifier directly after number'), so a raw-text consumer would fatal on exactly the harness this gate exists for.",

(3) `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter @object-ui/console type-check` -> exit 0. FIRST run was exit 2 with 22 TS2307 'Cannot find module @object-ui/core' errors in untouched files -- the stale-dist trap; `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build` (exit 0, under the shared verify lock, 207s) first, then clean. One real error of mine was found and fixed there: typescript-eslint exports its parser typed as a minimal compatibility shim, parseForESLint(text: string), so passing ecmaFeatures was TS2554; the signature is restated at that one boundary rather than importing @typescript-eslint/parser (which would be a phantom dependency). (4) `pnpm run lint:root` UNNARROWED -> exit 0, 'x 28 problems (0 errors, 28 warnings)'. (5) `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console lint` -> exit 0, 'x 203 problems (0 errors, 203 warnings)'. All warnings in both are pre-existing no-explicit-any; grep for my four filenames in both logs returns nothing. (6) Coverage of that zero proven separately: `eslint <the 4 touched files> --format json` reports 4 files, 0 errors / 0 warnings each, none ignored. (10) type-check:coverage '45/46 via type-check' + 'test type-check coverage: 41/41 packages compile their tests'. (11) check:esm-specifiers, check:vi-mock-specifiers, check:self-import all green. (12) check-changeset-presence.mjs: exit 1 BEFORE the changeset, exit 0 after -- see the changeset field.",
  "narrowing_declared": "The FULL root vitest suite did not converge in this container. `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` was started under the shared verify lock and killed by me at 21 minutes with no summary produced -- CPU-bound the whole time (237% CPU, 49m51s of CPU time), not hung, and killed BY PID only (4197/4185/4173/4172/31107), never by process name. A parallel agent's identical invocation on another worktree (issue-5992) ended the same way at 701s. Narrowed on this measurement: the diff is five files, NONE under any packages/*/src, so the root dom / dom-heavy / unit projects have no changed input; the only behaviour that can move is @object-ui/console's (test files only) and eslint-rules/'s, and both were run whole. The consumers of eslint-rules were derived by grep rather than recalled -- scripts/__tests__/{check-vi-mock-specifiers,turbo-lint-inputs,turbo-task-guard-coverage,vitest-invocation-guard}.test.ts -- and all are in set (2). Declared here and in the PR body.",
  "changeset": "ADDED, empty frontmatter: .changeset/5944-preview-page-source-query-params.md. The dispatch's premise that check-changeset-presence.mjs exits 0 either way is FALSE on this tree, measured: it exited 1 before the declaration with 'ERROR 1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change adds no changeset: @object-ui/console / apps/console/src/__tests__/sdui-preview-page-source-styling.test.ts'. Its header states the reason explicitly -- 'No carve-out for test files under src/. A change confined to src/__tests__/ is answered by the empty-frontmatter exemption, in one line.' After adding it: exit 0, 'Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter - declared as releasing nothing, which is the explicit exemption and a complete answer to this gate.' Nothing published changes: @object-ui/console's files list is dist + plugin.* + README.md. No skip-changeset label was created or applied -- that label does not exist in this repo and minting one by an add would be worse than useless.",

}
